'''Amit Noloff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who was a prominent leader on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Amit Noloff was a successful [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealer]] and a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who operated out of the planet Iego, though after being trapped in the<ref name="tcwce" /> [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="MoaTM" /> [[Cliffhold/Legends|Cliffhold]], was driven mad.<ref name="tcwce" />  
[[File:Amit_Noloff2.png|thumb|left|180px|Noloff confronting Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi.]]
Noloff was a firm believer in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] superstition about "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]," and warned [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] not to attempt to leave the planet due to the "ghost's curse". Skywalker and Kenobi successfully identified the so-called curse as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] defense system and navigated their way through. Arrogantly, Noloff refused to believe the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Still firm in his beliefs, Noloff expressed dismay upon hearing that the Jedi had successfully left the planet even as others cheered around him.<ref name="MoaTM" />

==Personality and traits==
Amit was firm believer in the curse of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] and tried to talk Anakin and Obi-Wan out of trying to leave the planet. Since he was a prominent leader on Iego, he must have been a good speaker to convince the other trapped spacers of his ideas.<ref name="MoaTM" /> The Quarren stood at 1.82 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]]) but had a stooped posture from frantic pacing. He had [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] limp with despair,<ref name="tcwce" /> pale [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin, and white [[Eye/Legends|eye]]s.<ref name="MoaTM" />

==Skills and abilities==
Noloff was talented in starship piloting and negotiating.<ref name="tcwce" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amit Noloff was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]].<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
His mouth differed from other [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren's]] mouths.
